title: 第410章 图纸出来了
slug: 离婚当天前夫小叔连夜抢我领证
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“小花，站着干啥，快过来，姑姑帮你洗澡。”

听到喊声，小花猛地回神，被自己刚刚的念头吓出了一身冷汗。

厉小棠放好了洗澡水，见小花迟迟不过来，干脆进来拉着她往外洗澡间走。

“瞧你这一脑门子汗，再不洗澡都要馊了，现在天气热，以后在外面玩，早点回家。”

小花的心脏扑通扑通跳得厉害，任由厉小棠拉着她走。

林见微回到房间，

等小花洗完澡出来，举到小花面前：“喏，送你一只小兔子，我们的小公主别不开心了，好不好呀？”

小花望着眼前这只毛茸茸的紫色兔子，它身着一袭白蕾丝小裙子，模样精致可爱，眼睛一下子亮了起来。

“这、这真的是送给我的吗？”

“当然。”

林见微把小兔子塞到她怀里。

小花捧着小兔子，脸颊软软地蹭上去，心里顿时开出了花。

她从没见过这么好看的玩偶，就连之前小棠姑姑带她去的百货大楼里，都找不到这般精致的。

要是把它拿出去，大院里的小伙伴肯定得羡慕死她。

“谢谢婶婶。”

林见微轻轻揉了揉她的头，“不客气。”

方安雅也拿着一套新衣服出来，“快来换上这件睡衣，天渐渐热了，你身上这件布料太厚，夜里睡觉容易闷热。这是的确良料子，穿着清爽凉快。”

小花抱着兔子跑过去，接过睡衣，去房间换。

浅粉色带着小碎花图案的睡衣很漂亮，穿在身上滑溜溜的，非常舒服。

晚上，小花穿着新睡衣，搂着小兔子，躺在床上，白天的不开心渐渐消散。

姑姑、婶婶和外婆，还是喜欢她，会对她好的，对吗？

要是能一直好下去，她就不排斥婶婶肚子里的孩子了。

林见微没有因为怀孕就懈怠下来。

每天早上照常去武研所，该开会开会，该画图画图，该加班加班。

只是不像以前那样熬到半夜才回家。

因为只要一过九点，厉野就会准时派毛根宝来催人。

Page (1/3)

"Xiaohua, what are you doing standing here? Come here quickly, Auntie will help you take a bath."

Hearing the shout, Xiaohua suddenly came back to her senses and broke into a cold sweat because of the thought she just had.

Li Xiaotang put the bath water, and when he saw that Xiao Hua was still coming, he simply came in and pulled her out to the bathroom.

"Look at the sweat on your forehead. You're going to go rancid if you don't take a shower. It's hot now. If you play outside from now on, go home early."

Xiaohua's heart was beating hard and she let Li Xiaotang pull her away.

Lin Jianwei returned to the room,

When Xiao Hua came out of the bath, he held it up to Xiao Hua and said, "Here, I'll give you a little rabbit. Our little princess won't be unhappy, okay?"

Xiaohua looked at the fluffy purple rabbit in front of her. It was wearing a white lace skirt. It looked exquisite and cute, and her eyes suddenly lit up.

"Is this really for me?"

"Of course."

Lin Jianwei stuffed the little rabbit into her arms.

Xiao Hua held the little rabbit and rubbed her cheek softly, and her heart suddenly blossomed.

She had never seen such a beautiful doll. Even in the department store where Aunt Xiaotang took her to before, she could not find such a delicate one.

If she took it out, the friends in the compound would definitely be jealous of her.

"Thank you, Auntie."

Lin Jianwei gently rubbed her head, "You're welcome."

Fang Anya also came out with a new set of clothes, "Come and put on these pajamas, the weather is getting hotter, and the fabric on your body is too thick, making it easy to get stuffy when you sleep at night. This is really good material, it is refreshing and cool to wear."

Xiaohua ran over with the rabbit in her arms, took the pajamas, and went to the room to change.

The light pink pajamas with small floral patterns are very beautiful, slippery and very comfortable to wear.

At night, Xiaohua put on her new pajamas, hugged the little rabbit, and lay on the bed. The unhappiness of the day gradually dissipated.

Aunt, aunt, and grandma still like her and will treat her well, right?

If she could keep getting better, she wouldn't reject the child in her aunt's belly.

Lin Jianwei didn't slack off just because she was pregnant.

I go to the Wuhan Research Institute as usual every morning. I have meetings when I should, drawing pictures when I should, and working overtime when I should.

It’s just that I don’t stay up until midnight before going home like I used to.

Because as soon as nine o'clock passes, Li Ye will send Mao Genbao to urge people on time.
